mesh_scatter_boulders — 3D terrain op

• Datenarten: mesh → mesh

• Aufruf: import render3d; render3d.mesh_scatter_boulders(V, F, *, density: 'float', d_min: 'float', d_max=None, exponent: 'float' = 3.1, seed: 'int' = 0, region_weights=None, aspect=(1.0, 0.7, 0.5), embed: 'float' = 0.35, subdiv: 'int' = 1, shape: 'str' = 'ellipsoid', orientation: 'str' = 'normal', burial=(0.3, 0.6), max_count=None, hull_points=None, return_info: 'bool' = False) (oder ops3d.get("mesh_scatter_boulders"))

Verwendung

> Für diesen Operator gibt es noch keine Übersetzung. Es folgt der Originaltext unverändert.

Scatter partly-buried boulders on a mesh (power-law sizes, seeded) → `(V, F)`
